notes.title: Hungarian language is now supported! +Minor updates and release of our new games
notes.notes:
With this new version, you can now play the game in Hungarian!
A big thank you to Numerolock for the translation! :)

Additionally, we have made the following updates:

- Fixed an issue where the language setting options did not switch correctly even after changing the language.
- Resolved a problem where the game would freeze when replacing, combining, or placing items in Vietnamese.
- Corrected the pitch of the sound effect for the [spoiler]empty glass[/spoiler].

[hr][/hr]

It's been about a year since the last announcement, and during that time, each of the two developers has released a new game. We hope you enjoy these as well.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1250630/Recolit/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2885880/_/

[hr][/hr]

For translations into other languages, please see the following thread
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2057080/discussions/0/3454842150488487381/

notes.title: Update v1.2.4 and future updates
notes.notes:
Once you have completed the game to the end, Start From "The Last Day" is now available in title menu. If you got achievements "The Last day" in previous versions, you can also use it.
 The volumes of some of SFX that was difficult to hear have been increased.


The following is a list of issues that we want to deal with, 
but we are still looking for a better way to do this, as it takes more time to implement and debug.


 Controller support
 Multi-language support


Due to the free game, we cannot spend much time on development and apologize for inconvenience.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update v.1.2.3
notes.notes: The default language at launch is changed to English. It only starts up in Japanese when the system language is set to Japanese.
